label: Proposed caregiving knowledge template — for discussion

design_basis.source: User-provided Saha team meeting, latest update
design_basis.passage: 14:30–16:25: proposed disease template with 15–20 dimensions, reviewed with Siddharth
design_basis.note: The exact dimensions are assistant-proposed implementation choices, not a verbatim or approved medical framework.

dimensions.title: Condition scope and applicability
dimensions.purpose_question: What condition, care setting, and limits does this module cover?

dimensions.title: Elder priorities and usual function
dimensions.purpose_question: What matters to this elder, and what assistance is normally needed?

dimensions.title: Onboarding questions and missing context
dimensions.purpose_question: What information should be collected before selecting care guidance?

dimensions.title: Existing clinician instructions and restrictions
dimensions.purpose_question: Which patient-specific instructions already exist, and what remains unconfirmed?

dimensions.title: Routine caregiving do's
dimensions.purpose_question: Which daily support activities may be relevant, subject to individual applicability?

dimensions.title: Don'ts and precautions
dimensions.purpose_question: What should not be done or assumed, and under which circumstances?

dimensions.title: Mobility, ambulation, and transfers
dimensions.purpose_question: What assistance, restrictions, or instructions need to be understood?

dimensions.title: Bathing, personal hygiene, and oral care
dimensions.purpose_question: What preferences, assistance needs, and existing care instructions are relevant?

dimensions.title: Comfort, posture, rest, and sleep
dimensions.purpose_question: What preferences or clinician-supplied instructions should be captured?

dimensions.title: Meals, nutrition, and hydration
dimensions.purpose_question: What assistance needs and documented restrictions must be considered?

dimensions.title: Toileting, continence, and skin care
dimensions.purpose_question: What support needs or existing plans should be captured without inventing treatment?

dimensions.title: Home environment and equipment
dimensions.purpose_question: What equipment, environmental context, and training requirements matter?

dimensions.title: Prescribed treatment support and adherence
dimensions.purpose_question: What existing schedule or instructions should be referenced, and who may perform the task?

dimensions.title: Caregiver-observable changes
dimensions.purpose_question: What changes from the person's usual situation can be reported without diagnosis?

dimensions.title: Prescribed monitoring and patient-specific limits
dimensions.purpose_question: What measurements, frequencies, and action instructions have actually been supplied?

dimensions.title: Brief contextual follow-up questions
dimensions.purpose_question: What minimal additional information would make an observation more useful?

dimensions.title: Escalation contacts and handover
dimensions.purpose_question: Who handles operational and clinical issues, and what information should be passed on?

dimensions.title: Caregiver capability and task burden
dimensions.purpose_question: What training, authorisation, language support, and workload must be considered?

dimensions.title: Daily documentation and communication
dimensions.purpose_question: How are task status, observations, unresolved questions, and handovers recorded?

dimensions.title: Practical care tips and family education
dimensions.purpose_question: What relevant additional support could be surfaced without overwhelming people?
